meta.author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Bubba)
meta.rule: safe_through = highest level L such that every level 1..L was cleared in at least 90% of runs; stuck_level = L + 1 (null when every level clears in 90% of runs).
meta.thin_rule: Fewer than 10 runs: at that size 90% means every single run, so one bad run moves the stuck level. Read median_levels next to it.
meta.survival_note: A run that cleared N levels cleared levels 1..N in order, so per-level rates fall level by level by construction; they are not independent measurements.
meta.near_line_rule: near_line = the stuck level is still cleared in 75%+ of runs: it missed the 90% bar by a run or two, so treat it as a soft spot.
meta.clock_rule: clock_shaped = the runs that stopped at the stuck level spent a median of 150+ actions on it before time ran out: grinding, not a wall at the first move.
